score 5/10: Umbrella canopy is a small flat slab that sits almost on the dog's head; it needs to be bigger, domed and lifted well clear of the head, like the concept; No umbrella handle below the paw, so the pole just ends at the fist; the J handle is missing; Only three legs: the front leg under the raised paw is missing, so the dog looks lopsided
comparing the renders with the concept

score 4/10: The umbrella canopy is a flat, square red slab with a bump on top. It should be a stepped dome that clearly rises to a centre tip.; Nothing holds the umbrella. The shaft floats beside the head with no raised white paw gripping it, which is the key action in the concept.; The shaft has no curved J handle at the bottom.

comparing the renders with the concept

score 5/10: The raised foreleg is a flat 2x6 white plate sticking straight out from the chest, so it reads as a shelf, not a paw holding the umbrella. It should be a tan leg ending in a white paw; The canopy is a flat, square-looking slab. The concept has a wide, clearly domed umbrella; it needs a wider rim and steeper stepped layers up to the top knob; The canopy is narrow next to the dog. In the concept the umbrella is about as wide as the dog is long
